title: Product Comparison Videos for Clearer Choices | AIVideosUGC
description: Show shoppers the difference between your colors, sizes or sets. One photo of both options becomes a comparison clip for listings, Shorts and paid ads.
h1: Make a Product Comparison Video of Your Own Options
lead: When shoppers cannot tell your colors, sizes or sets apart, they leave. Upload one photo of both options and get a comparison clip that makes the choice clear for listings and ads.

benefits.d: A moving side-by-side view shows size, finish or included pieces more clearly than a spec line. Buyers can see which option fits their need instead of opening a support chat or leaving.
One source photo with both options supplies a shared scale and light. You demonstrate a full range without staging each color or size in front of a camera.
Choose 1:1 for a product gallery, 16:9 for a description embed or 9:16 for Shorts. Lengths run 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, so a simple pair and a detailed feature walkthrough both fit.

benefits.t: Exact labels stay under your control
benefits.d: Add variant names, measurements and prices as editable text after download. Your numbers stay accurate, and the finished clip carries no AIVideosUGC watermark.

steps_lead: Choose a comparison style, add both options, generate. No second shoot and no studio setup.

steps.d: Add one clear photo that shows the two options at a similar scale.
Choose a side-by-side, fit or feature scene, then generate the clip.
Download the video and add variant names, measurements or prices in your editor.

faq.q: What is a product comparison video template?
faq.a: It is a ready-made side-by-side scene. Add two of your own options and generate a clip that helps shoppers choose.

faq.q: Do I need to write prompts to use these templates?
faq.a: No. Choose a comparison style, upload both options and generate. Step two can include one short line about the difference if you want.

faq.q: Who are comparison templates built for?
faq.a: Ecommerce sellers and agencies that show variants, sizes, finishes or sets on product pages and social ads.

faq.q: Can I compare two of my own products?
faq.a: Yes. Use the same source photo for two options in your range so the comparison stays clear and fair.

faq.q: Can one photo show both options?
faq.a: Yes. A clear frame with both products visible gives the scene one consistent reference.

faq.q: Can I compare colors, sizes or sets?
faq.a: Yes. The clip can show visible differences in color, size, finish or included pieces. Add exact specifications after download.

faq.q: How fast is a comparison video made?
faq.a: A clip is generated in minutes after you start the job, with no second shoot or studio booking.

faq.q: What does a comparison video cost?
faq.a: A 6-, 10-, 15- or 30-second clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits, shown before you run it.

faq.q: Can I use a comparison video in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no AIVideosUGC watermark and can run in your own ads, pages and posts. You remain responsible for product claims.

visual.overview: A comparison video puts two options side by side so shoppers can choose the size, finish or set that suits them.

steps.sourceTitle: Two sizes of an amber glass bottle
steps.sourceHint: Keep the small and large amber bottles, white droppers and blank labels fully visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded pair as the exact options: one small and one large amber glass dropper bottle with white rubber bulbs, ribbed white caps and blank white labels. Preserve each bottle silhouette, cap and relative size. An adult creator holds one bottle in each hand beside her face and says, "Here are the two sizes side by side." She raises both equally and finishes with the full bottles facing the lens. Bright vanity daylight, natural skin texture. Chest-up front-facing handheld framing. Sound: her voice and two soft bottle taps; no music.
